description: Browse journal lists and rankings (special-issue CFPs, CCF, highest impact factor, popularity, all), paginated. No keyword filtering — use search_journals for that.

field.description: Research field filter. Only for ranking=cfp or ranking=all (e.g. ranking=cfp with field=network = network journals with an open special issue, soonest deadline first)

ranking.description: cfp=special-issue calls for papers; ccf=CCF list; highest_if=highest impact factor; most_viewed/most_tracked=popularity; all=all journals

name: list_journals
